name_input: FINDOC FINVEST PRIVATE LIMITED; FINDOC FINVEST PVT. LTD
note: RISK-ONLY CHECK, as of 2026-11-26. Research was severely limited: the web_search tool returned 'Connection refused' (searx backend down) on both attempts, and fallback fetches to DuckDuckGo (html and lite endpoints) timed out; Bing returned only irrelevant, unrelated results (hair-extension and puppy-training pages), i.e. no usable search index. Consequently NO sanctions screening (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS Entity List), NO Indian court-record check (eCourts/NCLT), NO regulator-action check (SEBI/NSE/BSE/MCX/NCDEX/NSDL), NO credit-rating lookup (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) and NO Russia/CIS supply evidence check could be completed. All fields are therefore null = NOT VERIFIED, not 'clean'. The only primary source actually read is the company's own website https://www.findoc.com/ and https://www.findoc.com/about-us (fetched 2026-11-26), which self-describes Findoc as a stock-broking / financial-services group established 2012, member of NSE, BSE, MCX and NCDEX and an NSDL depository participant, with Hemant Sood as Promoter & Managing Director and Nitin Shahi as Executive Director. This is self-declared marketing content only and is NOT evidence of regulatory standing, absence of enforcement action, or absence of litigation. Note the material mismatch between the declared profile (IT/electronics trader, HS 844332/847130/851712) and the entity's actual self-described business (securities broking, PMS, FPI, algo trading) - flagged for the analyst, not a rejection ground. Per project rules, sanctions/court/criminal matters are never rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally if found. RECOMMENDATION: re-run sanctions, eCourts/NCLT, SEBI enforcement-order and credit-rating checks when the search backend is restored; do not treat nulls as clearance.
